name: What preparation do I need to do before drywall finishing begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before drywall finishing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall finishing starts, ensure all drywall panels are securely fastened, and any necessary framing or electrical work behind the walls is complete. Clear the work area of furniture, personal items, and delicate decorations. Protecting adjacent floors and surfaces with drop cloths is also important. This preparation helps our team work efficiently and protects your property during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before finishing, ensure drywall is secure, clear the work area, and protect nearby surfaces to streamline the process.
